high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the user "conscious_soulll." The post features a photograph of a tree trunk that has been exposed to lightning, revealing its intricate vascular system. The text accompanying the image reads: "This is a tree that got hit by lightning and it exposed its vascular system. Nature is so complex 🌿." The photo itself shows a close-up view of the tree trunk with a significant portion of the bark removed, exposing the inner wood and the detailed network of veins and fibers.
